title: ARWP Search and Agent Recommendations Registry
scope: Source-backed recommendations for public websites that want to remain discoverable, citable and operable across classic search, generative search and browser agents.

methodology.principle: ARWP records upstream requirements, opportunities and measurable signals. Passing a rule never guarantees crawling, indexing, ranking, citation or agent success.

implementationPacks.title: Search foundation
implementationPacks.goal: Make important pages discoverable, indexable and technically unambiguous before optional AI-search work.

implementationPacks.title: AI search + citation
implementationPacks.goal: Improve eligibility and make high-value evidence easier to retrieve and cite without inventing AI-only markup.

implementationPacks.title: Freshness without fake recency
implementationPacks.goal: Expose meaningful change signals and faster update notification while avoiding timestamp churn.

implementationPacks.title: Identity + provenance
implementationPacks.goal: Make authors, software and datasets resolvable to stable, truthful entities.

implementationPacks.title: Images, video + Discover
implementationPacks.goal: Create additional visual discovery surfaces around content that genuinely benefits from media.

implementationPacks.title: International
implementationPacks.goal: Route users and crawlers to real localized variants instead of duplicating language pages ambiguously.

implementationPacks.title: Local + commerce
implementationPacks.goal: Keep canonical business/product facts synchronized with platform-owned discovery surfaces.

implementationPacks.title: ChatGPT Search + Atlas
implementationPacks.goal: Separate search discovery, training policy, referral measurement and interactive-agent accessibility.

implementationPacks.title: Measure AI visibility
implementationPacks.goal: Use owner-side evidence instead of declaring success from implementation status.

implementationPacks.title: Agent-web experiments
implementationPacks.goal: Experiment with emerging agent protocols while preserving runtime evidence and maturity labels.

implementationPacks.title: Anti-cargo-cult guardrails
implementationPacks.goal: Avoid scaled query-page factories and speculative metadata that can create risk without user value.

rules.title: Meet Google Search technical eligibility
rules.claim: Google documents minimum technical requirements for indexing eligibility: Googlebot is not blocked, the page returns HTTP 200, and the page has indexable content. Eligibility does not guarantee indexing.
rules.automatedCheck: homepage HTTP success, robots access heuristic, noindex/X-Robots-Tag heuristic
rules.action: Fix crawl, HTTP and indexability blockers before optional Search or AI-search work.
rules.verify: URL Inspection plus ARWP HTTP/robots/indexability checks.

rules.title: Preserve Search and snippet eligibility for Google generative features
rules.claim: Google says AI Overviews and AI Mode use the normal Search foundation: a page must be indexed and eligible to appear with a snippet, with no additional AI-specific technical requirement.
rules.automatedCheck: search eligibility plus nosnippet/max-snippet:0 heuristic
rules.action: Keep intended public pages indexable and snippet-eligible.
rules.verify: Check indexing and robots/snippet directives on priority URLs.

rules.title: Publish useful original, non-commodity content
rules.claim: Google's 2026 generative-search guidance emphasizes unique viewpoints, first-hand experience, original value and non-commodity content instead of special AEO/GEO markup.
rules.action: Add first-hand evidence, examples, data, analysis or a distinct conclusion that cannot be replaced by a generic summary.
rules.verify: Manual evidence review against the page's target user need.

rules.title: Offer a Google Preferred Sources control when relevant
rules.claim: Google provides an interactive control that lets users add a domain or subdomain as a Preferred Source; indicators can appear in supported Google Search experiences.
rules.automatedCheck: detect Google preferred-source script, declarative button attribute or preferences/source link
rules.action: Expose the official control only where a repeat-reader relationship is plausible.
rules.verify: Confirm the control loads and points to the intended domain.
rules.notes: This is a user preference mechanism, not a general ranking guarantee.

rules.title: Keep important sections deep-linkable
rules.claim: Google recommends that content targeted by Read more deep links be immediately visible and that page code not remove fragments or force the user away from the linked section.
rules.automatedCheck: heading IDs plus suspicious fragment/scroll-reset patterns
rules.action: Give important sections stable IDs and avoid fragment-destroying navigation code.
rules.verify: Open representative #fragment URLs directly and confirm the intended section is visible.

rules.title: Publish accurate sitemap freshness metadata
rules.claim: Google supports sitemap lastmod when it is consistently and verifiably accurate and represents the last significant change to the page.
rules.automatedCheck: sitemap presence and syntactic lastmod observation; semantic accuracy remains manual
rules.action: Update lastmod only after meaningful page changes; do not rewrite it on every build.
rules.verify: Compare sitemap dates with actual content/repository changes.

rules.title: Do not accidentally block OAI-SearchBot when ChatGPT Search visibility is desired
rules.claim: OpenAI says sites that want content included in ChatGPT summaries and snippets should allow OAI-SearchBot. Search crawling and GPTBot training controls are separate decisions.
rules.automatedCheck: robots.txt OAI-SearchBot and wildcard access heuristic
rules.action: Allow OAI-SearchBot for public content you want discoverable while setting GPTBot policy independently.
rules.verify: Evaluate robots.txt separately for OAI-SearchBot and GPTBot.

rules.title: Notify participating engines about changed URLs with IndexNow
rules.claim: IndexNow defines a mechanism for notifying participating search engines when a URL is added, updated or deleted.
rules.action: Submit only real changed URLs and retain delivery receipts where possible.
rules.verify: Validate endpoint/key setup and record successful submission receipts.
rules.notes: Notification does not guarantee crawling or indexing.

rules.title: Measure Google generative-search visibility separately
rules.claim: Google Search Console provides dedicated generative AI performance views for Search and Discover; Google states the rollout reached all websites worldwide on August 31, 2026.
rules.action: Export generative-AI impressions/pages before and after material site changes.
rules.verify: Use authenticated Search Console data; never infer these metrics from public crawling.

rules.title: Measure AI citations and grounding-query signals in Bing Webmaster Tools
rules.claim: Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance reports show citation activity across supported Microsoft AI experiences, including cited pages and trends; Bing labels the feature public preview.
rules.action: Export citation and cited-page evidence around meaningful changes.
rules.verify: Use authenticated Bing Webmaster Tools data.

rules.title: Expose structured browser-agent tools only where useful and real
rules.claim: WebMCP lets web applications expose structured tools to browser agents. Chrome documents it as an origin-trial feature, not a stable universal web requirement.
rules.automatedCheck: not assessed by static audit; requires explicit browser runtime
rules.action: Use WebMCP only for real high-value actions where DOM inference is fragile.
rules.verify: Run browser-level task-completion evals.

rules.title: Evaluate WebMCP tool selection, execution and security
rules.claim: Chrome's WebMCP guidance recommends evals before production and separate security review because browser-agent tools can introduce agent-specific risks including prompt injection.
rules.automatedCheck: not assessed by static audit; attach runtime eval receipts when available
rules.action: Test correct tool selection, argument handling, authorization and prompt-injection boundaries.
rules.verify: Keep reproducible runtime eval receipts and a security review.

rules.title: Track IETF AIPREF Content-Usage preferences without treating the draft as final
rules.claim: draft-ietf-aipref-attach-05 defines work-in-progress attachment mechanisms for AI usage preferences through a Content-Usage HTTP header field and a Content-Usage robots.txt rule.
rules.automatedCheck: observe Content-Usage in homepage response headers and robots.txt; absence is not a failure
rules.action: Track and experiment only when a publisher has a concrete AI-usage policy.
rules.verify: Record the exact draft revision and observed syntax.
rules.notes: Internet-Drafts can change or expire and must not be represented as an RFC.

rules.title: Track the W3C Introduction Layer Community Group as an upstream discovery candidate
rules.claim: The W3C-hosted Introduction Layer Community Group was launched in August 2026 to explore machine-native resource identity, purpose, constraints and responsible-party discovery for agents. Community Group work is not automatically a W3C Recommendation.
rules.action: Watch upstream work; do not invent a competing mandatory manifest.
rules.verify: Promote only after a concrete interoperable specification emerges.

rules.title: Keep the publisher service map valid when ARWP is adopted
rules.claim: If a publisher chooses to expose an ARWP profile, it should validate and remain consistent with actually observable interfaces. ARWP profile presence itself is not a search ranking signal.
rules.automatedCheck: reuse ARWP scanner/profile validation
rules.action: Publish only capabilities that actually resolve and work.
rules.verify: Run ARWP profile validation and runtime checks where applicable.

rules.title: Make every important page reachable through crawlable internal links
rules.claim: Google says links help it discover pages and understand relevance, and recommends that every important page have at least one internal link from another page.
rules.automatedCheck: site graph and <a href> heuristics
rules.action: Link every priority URL from relevant hub/content pages using descriptive anchor text and real <a href> links.
rules.verify: Crawl the site graph and flag orphan priority URLs or script-only navigation.

rules.title: Keep canonical, internal links and sitemap inventory aligned
rules.claim: Google recommends selecting canonical URLs for duplicate or near-duplicate content and treats sitemap URLs as canonical suggestions.
rules.automatedCheck: canonical/sitemap/internal-link consistency profile
rules.action: Choose one canonical URL per content item and consistently link/sitemap that version; redirect retired duplicates where appropriate.
rules.verify: Compare rendered canonical, status/redirect chain, sitemap membership and internal-link targets.

rules.title: Do not make discovery depend unnecessarily on client-side JavaScript
rules.claim: Google can render JavaScript, but rendering is an additional processing phase and not all bots execute JavaScript; Google says server-side or pre-rendering remains a good idea and crawlable links should be present in rendered HTML.
rules.automatedCheck: initial HTML versus rendered-content review
rules.action: Prefer server-rendered or pre-rendered priority content/links and avoid blocked JS resources.
rules.verify: Compare initial response HTML with rendered HTML and URL Inspection output.

rules.title: Keep important information available as real text
rules.claim: Google's AI-feature guidance recommends making important content available in textual form while supporting it with useful images and video.
rules.action: Do not bury core claims, product facts or instructions only inside images, canvas, video or inaccessible widgets.
rules.verify: Review the rendered DOM and text-only representation of priority pages.

rules.title: Keep structured data consistent with visible page facts
rules.claim: Google recommends that structured data match visible text and content on the page; special AI-only schema is not required for AI Overviews or AI Mode.
rules.automatedCheck: structured-data versus visible-fact parity review
rules.action: Emit only page-type-appropriate facts that are actually present or grounded in first-party data.
rules.verify: Validate markup and compare high-value properties with visible content.

rules.title: Declare real language and regional variants with consistent hreflang
rules.claim: Google recommends explicitly indicating localized page variants; each hreflang set should reference itself and the other variants.
rules.automatedCheck: hreflang reciprocity and canonical checks
rules.action: Use one consistent hreflang method, reciprocal annotations and x-default where it genuinely fits.
rules.verify: Check reciprocal pairs, valid language/region codes, canonicals and indexability.

rules.title: Structure pages for people with clear sections and descriptive headings
rules.claim: Google's 2026 generative-AI guide explicitly recommends well-written content organized by paragraphs, sections and clear headings.
rules.action: Organize each page around the user's decision or task; put the answer/evidence under descriptive headings instead of a long undifferentiated narrative.
rules.verify: Manual outline review: each important section should be independently understandable and addressable.

rules.title: Do not mass-produce fan-out query variants without added value
rules.claim: Google warns that creating separate pages for many search or fan-out query variations primarily to manipulate ranking or generative responses can violate the scaled content abuse policy.
rules.action: Consolidate near-duplicate query variants into stronger canonical resources unless each page has distinct user value.
rules.verify: Review templated page families for unique evidence, purpose and substantive differentiation.

rules.title: Use clear structure, evidence and cross-format consistency for Bing AI citations
rules.claim: Bing's 2026 AI Performance guidance recommends improving structure and clarity with headings, tables and FAQ sections, supporting claims with evidence, keeping content fresh, and reducing ambiguity across text, images and video.
rules.action: Make key facts easy to locate, support material claims, and keep entity/product facts consistent across formats.
rules.verify: Use Bing AI Performance grounding/citation data plus manual page review.

rules.title: Provide strong large-image previews for Discover-suitable pages
rules.claim: Google recommends relevant high-quality Discover images at least 1200px wide, over 300,000 pixels, and enabled for large previews with max-image-preview:large or AMP.
rules.automatedCheck: image dimensions and robots preview policy
rules.action: Use a representative large image near the content and allow large previews unless policy requires otherwise.
rules.verify: Check image dimensions, stable URL, og:image/schema reference and max-image-preview policy.

rules.title: Make images understandable from surrounding context and useful alt text
rules.claim: Google recommends placing images near relevant text and using useful descriptive filenames and alt text; alt text also supports accessibility.
rules.automatedCheck: missing/generic alt and image context heuristics
rules.action: Use meaningful images near relevant copy, descriptive alt text and stable descriptive URLs without keyword stuffing.
rules.verify: Review priority images for context, alt text, crawlability and stable source URLs.

rules.title: Give important videos indexable watch surfaces and discoverable metadata
rules.claim: Google recommends discoverable video embeds, indexable watch pages when appropriate, valid thumbnails, and video metadata such as structured data or video sitemaps.
rules.automatedCheck: watch-page/indexability/video-metadata checks
rules.action: For strategically important videos, create a useful indexable watch page and expose stable thumbnail/video metadata.
rules.verify: Use Search Console video indexing plus page/render checks.

rules.title: Resolve article authors to real profile identities
rules.claim: Google's Article guidance supports author.url and recommends linking to a page dedicated to the author; ProfilePage markup can describe genuine author or contributor profiles.
rules.automatedCheck: author URL/profile consistency checks
rules.action: Show a real byline and link authors to stable profile pages with consistent identity.
rules.verify: Compare visible byline, Article author fields and the target profile page.

rules.title: Publish dataset identity, provenance, license and distributions
rules.claim: Google Dataset Search uses Dataset metadata for discovery and recommends provenance fields such as creator, identifier, license, sameAs and distributions where available.
rules.automatedCheck: Dataset property and landing-page parity checks
rules.action: Give every real dataset a stable landing page with description, creator/publisher, identifiers, license and downloadable distributions where known.
rules.verify: Validate Dataset markup and confirm identifiers/licensing against the actual artifact.

rules.title: Use SoftwareApplication only on genuine software/app pages
rules.claim: Google supports SoftwareApplication structured data for eligible app pages and documents required and recommended properties for software-app rich results.
rules.automatedCheck: SoftwareApplication property and visible-fact checks
rules.action: Describe real software products with accurate SoftwareApplication/WebApplication metadata when the page and offer facts support it.
rules.verify: Validate with Rich Results Test and compare all commercial facts with visible/first-party data.

rules.title: Keep Merchant Center and Business Profile facts current when relevant
rules.claim: Google's AI-feature guidance says Merchant Center and Business Profile information should be kept up to date because these sources can support shopping and local experiences.
rules.action: Synchronize product/local facts such as availability, hours and business identity with the live site and owner-managed profiles.
rules.verify: Compare site facts with Merchant Center and/or Business Profile owner data.

rules.title: Keep Bing Places business facts current for local AI discovery
rules.claim: Bing's AI Performance guidance recommends current Bing Places information for local businesses so key details such as address, hours and contact information remain eligible across supported experiences.
rules.action: Claim and maintain the business entity in Bing Places when local visibility matters.
rules.verify: Compare Bing Places owner data with the website's canonical business facts.

rules.title: Measure ChatGPT search referrals with OpenAI's UTM source
rules.claim: OpenAI says ChatGPT automatically includes utm_source=chatgpt.com in referral URLs, enabling publishers to measure inbound traffic from ChatGPT search results.
rules.action: Create a dedicated analytics segment for utm_source=chatgpt.com and preserve landing-page/query context where privacy policy allows.
rules.verify: Use first-party analytics; do not infer visits from crawler logs.

rules.title: Use accurate ARIA semantics for interactive browser-agent compatibility
rules.claim: OpenAI's current publisher/developer guidance says ChatGPT Agent in Atlas uses ARIA labels and roles to interpret page structure and interactive elements.
rules.action: Use correct native HTML first, then descriptive ARIA roles, labels and states where needed for controls, menus and forms.
rules.verify: Run accessibility checks and an agent task-completion test; avoid invalid or misleading ARIA.
